_comment: Issue #1362: '📡 Team Presence Board'. Real last comment is a presence-board heartbeat whose free-text narration describes OTHER issues' dispositions ('…处理并带有效终态/in-progress disposition') — isAiAgentComment() correctly recognizes it as machine-authored (📡 opener + sweep-trace marker + Generated-by footer), but before this fix isNonTerminalAiComment() then false-positived on the incidental substring 'in-progress' inside that narration (it describes other issues' state, not this heartbeat's own state), so the board was repeatedly re-flagged as unfinished work. Reference: arc#3465.
